answer: Proposal: pay answers only to accounts holding a one-per-person credential from in-person events, where the issuer biometrically dedups across all events; every issuance lands in a public atlas — an append-only log auditable for spikes. Credentials decay unless their human re-verifies at random later events, so a sybil vine can't feed its leaves from one root: each leaf needs a distinct rented human per period — linear cost, but total take ≤ recruitable humans × per-credential cap. No fable of trustlessness: the issuer's dedup is the named root; seams: bribery, paid attendance.
